Endpoint scenarios are deterministic API fixtures; the database seeder uses the datasets section.
Products enter stock through confirmed direct product batches; legacy sourcing endpoints are intentionally absent.
Admin access uses is_employee for staff access and is_admin only for protected employee/destructive actions; role and permission matrices are intentionally absent.
The default realistic seed uses the single seeded HajjMart administrator for staff attribution; additional employees are created only through Employee Management.
